properties.property: CREATE TABLE agent_session_local ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas ( sessionId String COMMENT '会话id', createTime DateTime COMMENT '创建时间', lastAccessTime DateTime COMMENT '最后访问时间', userId String COMMENT '用户id', agentId String COMMENT '代理id', title String COMMENT '会话标题', domain String COMMENT '会话所属领域' ) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree('/clickhouse/tables/{shard}/{database}/{table}', '{replica}') ORDER BY (sessionId)
drop TABLE agent_session_local ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas
CREATE TABLE agent_session on cluster vops_3shards_1replicas AS agent_session_local ENGINE = Distributed(vops_3shards_1replicas, currentDatabase(), agent_session_local, rand())
drop TABLE agent_session ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas

CREATE TABLE agent_session_message_local ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas ( msgId String COMMENT '消息id', createTime DateTime COMMENT '创建时间', sessionId String COMMENT '会话id', requestId String COMMENT '请求id', traceId String COMMENT 'trace id', parentAgentId String COMMENT '父智能体id', agentId String COMMENT '创建或者消息所属的agentid,如果节点类型是串行容器智能体节点（sequence）、并行容器智能体节点（parallel），对应创建消息的agentid为subAgentIdBy对应的值', agentNodeType String COMMENT '智能体节点类型：标准化智能体节点（standard）、串行容器智能体节点（sequence）、并行容器智能体节点（parallel）', subAgentIdBy String COMMENT '创建消息的子agentid，节点类型是串行容器智能体节点（sequence）、并行容器智能体节点（parallel）有值', messageType String COMMENT '0 代表子智能体辅助消息， 1 代表子智能体输出结果 2 代表用户输入消息 3 智能体系统消息 5 智能体跟踪消息 是否是agent的最终结果消息（messageType=1），需要加载到父agent的记忆消息中', seqNo Int32 COMMENT '消息序号', message String COMMENT '消息正文', tokenMetrics String COMMENT 'token消耗统计', elapsed Int32 COMMENT '耗时', role String COMMENT '角色', marks String COMMENT '消息标记', metadata String COMMENT '消息元数据' ) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree('/clickhouse/tables/{shard}/{database}/{table}', '{replica}') ORDER BY (sessionId, createTime,seqNo)
drop TABLE agent_session_message_local ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas

CREATE TABLE agent_session_message on cluster vops_3shards_1replicas AS agent_session_message_local ENGINE = Distributed(vops_3shards_1replicas, currentDatabase(), agent_session_message_local, sipHash64(sessionId))
drop TABLE agent_session_message ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas

CREATE TABLE agent_session_message_ref_local ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas ( msgId String COMMENT '消息id', msgAgentId String COMMENT '消息所属智能体agentId', refAgentId String COMMENT '引用消息智能体agentId', sessionId String COMMENT '会话id', requestId String COMMENT '请求id' ) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree('/clickhouse/tables/{shard}/{database}/{table}', '{replica}') ORDER BY (sessionId)
drop TABLE agent_session_message_ref_local ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas

CREATE TABLE agent_session_message_ref on cluster vops_3shards_1replicas AS agent_session_message_ref_local ENGINE = Distributed(vops_3shards_1replicas, currentDatabase(), agent_session_message_ref_local, sipHash64(sessionId))
drop TABLE agent_session_message_ref ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas
